rejectedProductTypes.reason: Sarongs and beach towels: not fitted garments, accessory flow (ENGINE-HANDOFF Phase 4).
Accessory: no 3D asset; accessories stay on today's flow (ENGINE-HANDOFF Phase 4).
Catch-all type for tees, tops and dresses that belong to Tops or Dresses (e.g. starlight-cotton-*-tee, coastal-breeze-maxi-dress); not a separate category.
Untyped products (a cami top and a lounge set) that duplicate Tops and sets.

Clothing category WITHOUT a validation product (see SHOP_UNCOVERED_CATEGORIES): the engine has no combined dress + bottom anchor subset for overalls, jumpsuits and pant suits yet. The founder accepts this gap or asks for a product from it.

uncoveredClothingCategories.reason: No validation product: jumpsuits, overalls and pant suits span the torso and the legs, and the engine has no combined dress + bottom anchor subset for them yet (anchoring, calibration and grading would have to be added first). It was left out for this technical reason, not on scope grounds; the founder decides whether to accept the gap or to add one product from this category.

method.sizeChart: AU size options use AU_WOMENS_BODY_CHART (@curtain/schema, docs/research/au-size-chart.md) restricted to the sizes offered, sizeChartType 'body'; S-M style options use the mean of the AU rows the stated range covers; one-size items use flat measurements from the text as a 'garment' chart.
method.baseSize: AU 12 (or the range that holds it) for every size-ranged item: our default, not stated by the shop. GarmentPayload v1 has no baseSize field, so it sits beside the payload.
method.ease: Only where the shop prints garment measurements: printed value at the base size minus the AU body chart at the base size.
method.fabric: The fabric sentence of the description (labels, percentages, "crafted from", never styling advice) through resolveFabricText/fabricFromText; the fabric library fills weight, stretch, drape, opacity and sheen. `blend` only when the text states the composition ("100% rayon", "65% acrylic 35% wool"); a bare fibre name ("rayon") gives no blend and a warning.
method.images: images.json: every image looked at and classified by hand; sha256 of the file as downloaded.
